releases.name: Village in the Shade
releases.summary: Quiet countryside living…as long as you follow the rules. Welcome to Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village with plenty of secrets. In this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim, you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and meet a cast of intriguing characters—all with something to hide. Enjoy quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

releases.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
releases.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

releases.name: VALHEIM CITY BUILDER
releases.summary:
Can you build a Viking city strong enough to survive the wild?

Build a mighty Viking settlement and guide your people toward a prosperous future in VALHEIM CITY BUILDER, a strategy and simulation game focused on construction, exploration, resource management, and tactical combat. Begin with a small settlement and develop it into a thriving Viking city capable of surviving the dangers of an untamed world.

Gather resources, construct essential buildings, manage your population, and expand into new territories. Hunt for food, trade with other clans, strengthen your defenses, and prepare your warriors for dangerous encounters as your settlement grows.

Key Features:
• Build Your City – Construct new buildings and expand your Viking settlement.
• Manage Resources – Gather materials, hunt for food, and trade with other clans.
• Explore New Lands – Discover new territories, resources, and opportunities for expansion.
• Defend & Fight – Strengthen your defenses and lead your warriors into tactical battles.
• Develop Your Clan – Train your people and improve their skills as your settlement grows.

releases.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
releases.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

releases.name: Sirokuma Clicker
releases.summary:
Touch the screen! Mash the buttons! A polar bear paradise anytime, anywhere.

It's just simple clicking, but you won't be able to stop...!

The idle clicker game Sirokuma Clicker is now available on Nintendo Switch™!

Click (or tap) the adorable polar bear to boost production, and unlock a variety of facilities and upgrades. Watch the bears multiply at mind-blowing speeds as you build your very own polar bear empire!

releases.name: Slime Jump
releases.summary:
The only way for the little slug to survive is to jump from island to island.

The entire world consists of nothing but ruined islands in the sky.

Collect coins and grow stronger.

This game will not only captivate you but also help improve your agility, speed, and visual acuity.

releases.name: Subliminal Backrooms Horror
releases.summary:
Your darkest memories are waiting to be uncovered.

Step into the subconscious of a troubled man undergoing an experimental therapy through controlled lucid dreams.

Explore distorted memories from different stages of his life, where familiar places become unsettling nightmares shaped by loneliness, rejection, fear, and trauma. Search for forgotten locations, discover meaningful objects, solve mysterious puzzles, and uncover fragments of a past that has been buried deep within his mind.Each level represents a different chapter of his life, taking you from childhood to adolescence as reality slowly gives way to disturbing visions and psychological horrors.

Explore interconnected areas, unlock new paths, restore your spiritual strength, and prepare for terrifying encounters with the manifestations of his deepest fears. Every memory reveals another piece of his story, while every confrontation brings him closer to overcoming the trauma that has haunted him.

Key Features:
• Explore Distorted Memories: Discover unsettling locations from the protagonist’s past.
• Solve Mysterious Puzzles: Crack codes, manipulate mechanisms, and uncover hidden paths.
• Experience Psychological Horror: Face disturbing events, visual distortions, and manifestations of fear.
• Confront Your Trauma: Restore your spiritual strength and battle terrifying bosses representing the protagonist’s deepest fears.

releases.name: Sunshine Farm
releases.summary:
Sunshine Farm is a farming simulator with shop management.

Grow your farm, explore a vast world, expand the fair, and run a successful store.

releases.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
releases.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

releases.name: Devil & Angel Sky Battle
releases.summary: High above the stars, an angel and a devil circle a gleaming board and fight the oldest argument there is — with clouds.Take turns flying around the board's edge, pick a row or a column, and hurl your cloud in from either end. Your cloud lands on the first square and everything in its path slides along one place. Run out of room and the cloud at the far end is shoved clean off the edge, where it bursts in a shower of light.Make a full line of your own clouds — across, down or corner to corner — and you win.The catch is that nothing ever stays where you put it. Every throw your opponent makes can push your careful row apart, or nudge one of your own clouds into a line you never planned. A board that looks lost can turn in a single shove. There are no safe squares, only the ones your rival hasn't reached yet.Two house rules keep the fight moving: nobody may play the same throw three times running, and nobody may answer a throw by shoving the same line straight back. No stalemates, no endless tug of war — just position, pressure and the nerve to commit.Play your waySet the board up how you like it before each match:- Grid size — 3×3 for a quick knife fight, 4×4 and 5×5 for real strategy, or 6×6 for a long war of attrition- Board starting fill — begin on an empty board at 0%, or dive straight into the chaos at 30%, 60% or 90% full- Pick your side — take the angel's white clouds or the devil's thunderheads; your opponent takes the other- Who plays — each side can be a player or the console, so play head to head, take on the machine, or sit back and watch two AIs fight it out- Four levels of opponentBeginner, Rookie, Experienced and Expert. Even the gentlest opponent thinks several moves ahead and sets traps of its own — the harder levels simply stop making mistakes. The Expert sees six moves deep and does not forgive a loose cloud.Features- One or two players, side by side on the same console- Four board sizes and four starting fills — sixteen ways to set up a match- Four difficulty levels with a genuinely thinking opponent- Diagonals count, on every board size- Your record against the console is kept for each board size- Instant rematches — win, watch the board clear, and go again

releases.name: Fitness Club Simulator 2027
releases.summary:
Build, manage, expand, and take your gym to the top.

Turn a small gym into the next fitness sensation and build a business that makes an impact across the city. Start with a simple space, make smart investments, and transform your first location into a thriving destination where people come to train, improve, and reach their goals. Every decision shapes your success as you turn ambition into a growing fitness empire.

Explore the city, discover new opportunities, and open additional gyms in different locations. Design each space your way, upgrade your facilities, manage your staff, and create a recognizable brand that keeps attracting new clients. Balance your finances, reputation, and daily operations as your business grows from a modest gym into a name the entire city knows.

Key Features:
• Build Your Fitness Empire: Start with one gym and expand your business across the city.
• Design Unique Gyms: Customize layouts, equipment, atmosphere, and the overall look of every location.
• Upgrade and Expand: Invest in better equipment, new facilities, and additional areas to unlock new possibilities.
• Manage Your Business: Hire staff, control expenses, and make strategic decisions to keep your gyms running efficiently.
• Create Your Brand: Develop a distinctive fitness identity and build a reputation that attracts more clients.

releases.name: Omni Growth
releases.summary: The last hope of your species. Consume your prey, evolve, and turn an abandoned galactic ship into your personal hunting grounds as you become a deadly predator.

releases.name: Tape to Tape
releases.summary:
Explore a gorgeous roguelite hockey world where every choice matters on your journey to restore hockey to its former glory. Hire unique players, manage your benchwarmers, discover synergies between them, choose new abilities, bribe the referees, visit the Blademaster for upgrades and a lot more.

Take charge of a ragtag group of hockey players in a roguelite journey across a mysterious land. As the newly appointed captain, every choice matters on your path to discover the secret of hockey's last bastion. Hire superstars, utilize the synergy found between players, and harness ruthless abilities, all in favor of crafting an unbeatable team.

releases.name: Seahorse Soap Patrol
releases.summary:
A squad of seahorses must send polluters packing!

When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse
Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes,
blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick
up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.

releases.name: Vixen 357
releases.summary: This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

releases.name: Bad Dog
releases.summary:
Who's a Bad Boy?

Unlock total puppy mayhem in this hilarious first-person 3D dog simulator! Forget being a "good boy" - let's create chaos! Pull off wild pranks and turn Granny's calm home into a disaster zone!

Take control of a mischievous hound from a dog’s-eye perspective. Your goal? Cause non-stop chaos without getting caught! Shred couch cushions. Snatch sausages from the kitchen counter. Knock over pricey TVs. Terrorize the spoiled cat. Earn chaos points, explore the neighborhood, unlock cute puppy breeds, and prove you are the ultimate troublemaker on four legs.

KEY FEATURES:
• First-Person 3D Dog Simulator: Experience the world from a floor-level puppy perspective. Run, jump, bark, bite, and cause havoc with playful physics!
• Funny Home Mayhem: Break pottery, rip furniture, spill drinks, and create a mess in every room.
• Prank Granny: Execute sneaky pranks, grab tasty food from the table, set off noisy traps, and outwit the furious household.
• Suburban Sandbox Exploration: Step out of the living room and into the backyard or city streets. You’ll find hidden secrets, fun mini-games, and new places to dig.
• Unlock Cute Breeds & Custom Styles: Use your chaos points to unlock various dog breeds, quirky accessories, unique fur patterns, and awesome puppy bonuses!

releases.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
releases.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

releases.name: SCP-3008: Infinite Store
releases.summary:
The loop is never ending...

Everything feels safe and ordinary at first. Pristine showroom floors, orderly shelving, and familiar home decor stretch out before you. But as you step deeper into the endless corridors, you will quickly realize that repetition is your enemy in this first-person psychological horror anomaly game.

Every room you enter is either right or wrong. Inspect the scenery and listen closely to the audio. If you notice even the subtlest anomaly, turn back immediately. If the room is completely normal, press forward. Make a single mistake, and the entire loop resets.

But escaping isn't just about choosing the right door. Scattered throughout the showrooms are items from a shifting shopping list. You must locate and collect every item while navigating the endless maze. Miss a single item, and the checkout exit will lock you inside forever. There are no weapons, no map, and no UI hints. Your memory is your only lifeline.

Key Features:
• First-Person Anomaly Hunt: Test your memory and attention to detail. Search for subtle audio, visual, and environmental anomalies hidden across repeating rooms.
• The Endless Liminal Superstore: Explore an infinite 3D labyrinth of modern furniture displays, creepy showrooms, and disorienting corridors.
• Shifting Shopping List: You must find and collect specific grocery and home items. Only then can you unlock the final checkout exit.
• Pure Psychological Horror: No weapons, no radar, and no UI hints. Your observation skills and quick decisions are your only weapons against the loop.

releases.name: No Exit 9
releases.summary:
Something has changed. Find the anomaly before it finds you.

You are trapped in a place that looks familiar—but something is wrong.

Walk through a series of mysterious corridors and search for anomalies hidden in the environment. A painting may change. A door may appear where it shouldn't. A light may behave strangely. Something that was there before may suddenly be gone.

Pay attention to every detail.

If you spot an anomaly, turn back. If everything looks normal, keep moving forward. One wrong decision could send you deeper into the loop.

No Exit 9 features nine challenging levels, each filled with subtle changes, unsettling details, and unexpected events. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what is real and what has changed.

There is no map. No guide. No second chance to ignore what you see.

Observe your surroundings, remember what was there before, and trust your instincts.

Can you identify every anomaly and find your way out?

releases.name: 123 Halloween Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies 1+
releases.summary: A cheerful Halloween learning game for toddlers and preschoolers! Discover numbers 1 to 10, practice counting, hear spoken numbers in 14 languages, pop balloons, play memory, roll the dice, solve puzzles and enjoy a fun little truck adventure.

releases.name: Heart-Pounding Office Puzzle with My Boss
releases.summary:
Enjoy a light, heart-pounding office life with a boss who always seems to set the pace, all through an easygoing puzzle game!

Whether you are in work mode or taking a quick break, somehow you are never quite in control. Take on a variety of office-themed situations and enjoy the little thrills that unfold as you play.

releases.name: Isekai Princess: Monster Siege
releases.summary:
A princess and a soldier who were never meant to meet team up in another world! An arcade-style 2D side-scrolling shooter you can't put down.

Princess Lucia lost her homeland to the Demon Lord's army. Soldier Yuna survived a war with no end in sight. Swept up in a mysterious light, the two land in a strange isekai world and must fight monsters to get back to the places they call home. Both heroines battle with real-world rifles and pistols, but each has her own style. Pick your favorite and take on the stages. Your loyal pet dragon is always ready to unleash a special attack and turn a desperate moment around.

・Two heroines with plenty of personality. Play as Lucia or Yuna.
・Blast through monsters with rifles and pistols in fast, satisfying shooting action.
・Hunt for hidden survival items tucked away in every stage.
・Spend the cash you collect at the shop to buy new weapons and upgrades.
・Count on your pet dragon for special attack support.
・Grow stronger with every stage you clear.
・Upgrade weapon power, health, attack range, and more to build a strategy that's all yours.
・Face tougher enemies and fiercer bosses the deeper you go.
・Enjoy story scenes in every stage and a heartfelt ending.

The controls are easy to learn but deep enough to master, and the tension will have your palms sweating. Add the thrill of wiping out a swarm in one blast, and you get a "just one more run" kind of addiction. Reach the final stage and an emotional ending awaits, one that decides the fate of Princess Lucia and Soldier Yuna. Will the two make it home safely? Only you can find out. Defeat the final bosses of this other world and write the end of their story!

Prologue
Princess Lucia was driven from her homeland when the Demon Lord's monsters invaded. Meanwhile, in the real world, soldier Yuna fought to survive a war with no end in sight. Two women who were never meant to meet found their fates joined by a sudden, unexplained power. Swallowed by a blinding light, they arrived somewhere that was home to neither of them, an unknown isekai world.

Lucia and Yuna came face to face in a strange land. But before they could catch their breath, a fresh wave of enemies attacked. With no way home and no idea why they had been brought here, the two joined forces to survive. They came from different worlds and fought for different reasons, yet one shared wish bound them together. Both longed to return to the places they call home and bring peace back to their lives.

Enemies of this other world keep blocking their path. Will there be a clue to getting home beyond them? Lucia fights to take back her stolen kingdom, and Yuna fights for a life untouched by war. Trusting each other, they step into the unknown. Can you lead them both safely home? Their fate is now in your hands.

releases.name: Glasses Waifu: Cozy Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Take a cozy break with cute glasses girls

Ready for a relaxing little puzzle break?

Enjoy charming illustrations of laid-back girls who look great in glasses, from quiet reading time to relaxing at a café or taking a nap. Compare the two pictures and find the subtle difference hiding among the details.

How to play:
・Look closely at the two pictures side by side
・Find one spot in the picture on the right that differs from the left
・Tap the difference to clear the puzzle

The simple rules make it easy to enjoy, even if you are new to puzzle games. It is perfect for a quick break, a little downtime, or whenever you want to slow down and relax.

A great fit for:
・Players who love cute girls with glasses
・Fans of cozy, soothing illustrations
・Spot-the-difference fans
・Anyone looking for a quick casual game
・Players who want to test their observation skills

Take your time admiring each girl’s expressions and gestures, or race to find the answer as quickly as you can. Enjoy a relaxing solo session, or turn the search into a fun challenge for a livestream audience.
